text: The one breaking change is #13172 in BCApps: the AI Test Toolkit command-line page can export structured AI eval run data, and Agent Task replaces the record-based GetLogEntryDetails method with public GetTaskLogEntryDetails overloads, so callers must switch. #13506 moves Marketing Text, Sales Lines Suggestions and Item Substitution to GPT-5.6, and #13495 does the same for Sales Order Agent auxiliary calls and refines default availability dates. #13508 adds a Key Vault switch for E-Document LLM calls, and #13469 hides the Sales Order Agent duplicate-contact notification on outgoing email. Expense Agent adds View rules links in the setup wizard (#13182, #13184) and VAT settings on the category card (#13504), and fixes itemization rounding and currency code (#13185), non-refundable lines blocking release (#12985) and special characters in account filters (#13460). Posting fixes cover return orders linked to posted sales invoices (#13417, #13547), partial purchase invoicing with non-base units (#13396), ACY across posting groups (#13488), reverse production entry (#12520) and production order refresh (#12161). Localization fixes cover Belgian Intervat (#13481, #13484), Swiss SEPA addresses (#13273, #13301) and French direct debit (#11596). Other fixes touch Fixed Asset List refresh (#13340, #13483), reminders (#13336), financial report negative formats (#13339) and Prices Overview (#9181), and #9527 opens E-Document Emailing to other extensions. BCQuality adds an AddLoadFields article (#253) and keeps comments in evaluation samples (#227).

issues: Every claim checks out: all 30 pull requests are cited correctly, and #13172 is correctly the only breaking change.
The paragraph was about 228 words, over the 220-word limit. I tightened the wording to bring it under.
The closing 'BCQuality adds #227 and #253' said nothing about what they do. I replaced it with a short description of each.
Small clarification: #13469 now says it is the Sales Order Agent's notification, and #9527 now says the change lets other extensions use E-Document Emailing.
